extracted.name: Strawberry Overnight Oats
extracted.description: This easy Strawberry Overnight Oats recipe is nutritious, yummy, and the perfect make-ahead, grab-and-go breakfast for weekday morning. It only takes 5 minutes and can easily be vegan or gluten free.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/4 cups unsweetened vanilla almond milk (, or any milk)
instruction_lines: Mix oats, yogurt, milk, and chia seeds together.
Divide between two 8oz or larger containers. Refrigerate overnight.
Top with strawberry and banana before eating.
categories: How to make strawberry overnight oats
Strawberry overnight oats with chia seeds
